酒精.e: What pain are you trying to cover up with alcohol?

香水.s: 你知道男孩子送女孩子香水代表什么吗？
香水.p: Nǐ zhīdào nánháizi sòng nǚháizi xiāngshuǐ dàibiǎo shénme ma?
香水.e: Do you know what it means for a man to give a woman perfume?

景象.s: 看见这副景象，我不禁叹了口气。
景象.p: Kànjiàn zhè fù jǐngxiàng, wǒ bùjīn tàn le kǒuqì.
景象.e: Seeing this scene, I couldn’t help but sigh.

建筑物.s: 这座建筑物将在城市建造。
建筑物.p: Zhè zuò jiànzhùwù jiàng zài chéngshì jiànzào.
建筑物.e: This building will be built in the city.

隔壁.p: Tā zhù zài tā de gébì.
隔壁.e: She lives next door to him.

披.s: 她披上一件外套，上了路。
披.p: Tā pī shàng yí jiàn wàitào, shàng le lù.
披.e: She threw on a coat and set off.

风雨.e: We were caught in a storm.

漏洞.s: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
漏洞.p: Zhèbú shì yìge lòudòng, érshì yìge méiyǒu xiě jìn wéndàng de tèxìng.
漏洞.e: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.

不适.s: 那件家具不适合摆在客厅。
不适.p: Nà jiàn jiājù búshì hé bǎi zài kètīng.
不适.e: That piece of furniture is not fitting for the living room.

持久.s: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
持久.p: Shēnghuó zhōng juéduì méiyǒushénme shì chíjiǔ de.
持久.e: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

柔软.s: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。
柔软.p: Zhè tiáo máojīn péngsōng yòu róuruǎn, tèbié shūfu.
柔软.e: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!

剧烈.s: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。
剧烈.p: Jìnyíbù de jiǎnchá fāxiàn tóugǔ shòudào jùliè de zhuàngjī ér suìliè.
剧烈.e: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.

区分.p: Nǐ xūyào qūfēn shàn yǔ è.
区分.e: You should distinguish between right and wrong.

珍珠.s: 他的牙齿白得像珍珠一样。
珍珠.p: Tā de yáchǐ bái de xiàng zhēnzhū yíyàng.
珍珠.e: His teeth are white like a pearl.

撤销.s: 亨利因为伤了手臂而被撤销了比赛资格。
撤销.p: Hēnglì yīnwèi shāng le shǒubì ér bèi chèxiāo le bǐsài zīgé.
撤销.e: Harry had to back out of the competition because of a broken arm.

特地.s: 汤姆站在威斯敏斯特地铁站的站台上。
特地.p: Tāngmǔ zhàn zài wēi sī mǐn sī tèdì tiě zhàn de zhàntái shàng.
特地.e: Tom stood on the platform in Westminster Underground Station.

挫折.s: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
挫折.p: Yígèrén de yùdào duōdà de cuòzhé cái huì zìshā?
挫折.e: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?

构造.s: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？
构造.p: Shíyàn gòuzào shì zěnyàng de? Tāmen shì rúhé xiānglián jiē de?
构造.e: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?

快捷.s: 我在桌面上建了一个快捷方式。
快捷.p: Wǒ zài zhuōmiàn shàng jiàn le yìge kuàijiéfāngshì.
快捷.e: I created a shortcut on the desktop.

精确.s: 精确性在数学中很重要。
精确.p: Jīngquè xìng zài shùxué zhōng hěn zhòngyào.

酱油.s: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。
酱油.p: Bǎ mǐfàn hé jīdàn jí jiàngyóu hùnyí xià.
酱油.e: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.

榜样.p: Nín zuò le gè huài bǎngyàng.

顽强.s: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。
顽强.p: Jǐnguǎn shòudào bàojūn de pòhài, yīngxióng hái wánqiáng de dòuzhēng.
顽强.e: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.

戒指.p: Tāmen dài zhe ángguì de jièzhi.

村庄.p: Zhèjiù shì wǒ chūshēng de cūnzhuāng.
村庄.e: That's the village I was born in.

花生.s: 不要忘记汤姆对花生过敏。
花生.p: Búyào wàngjì Tāngmǔ duì huāshēng guòmǐn.
花生.e: Don't forget Tom is allergic to peanuts.

淋.s: 我在回家路上被雨淋了。
淋.p: Wǒ zài huíjiā lùshang bèi yǔ lín le.
淋.e: I was rained on on my way home.

导师.p: Tā shì shùxué xì de dǎoshī.
导师.e: He is a tutor for the math department.

适度.s: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。
适度.p: Shìdù de yùndòng ràng shēnxīn huànrányìxīn.
适度.e: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.

源于.s: 我的建议源于我的经验。
源于.p: Wǒ de jiànyì yuányú wǒ de jīngyàn.
源于.e: My advice is predicated on my experience.

垂直.s: 垂直的金发滑过她的肩膀。
垂直.p: Chuízhí de jīnfà huá guò tā de jiānbǎng.
垂直.e: Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.

诗歌.s: 比起小说，他更喜欢诗歌。
诗歌.p: Bǐqǐ xiǎoshuō, tā gēng xǐhuan shīgē.

壶.s: 你要喝什么茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？
壶.p: Nǐ yào hē shénme chá? Pào hú níngméng hóngchá hǎo ba?
壶.e: What tea do you drink? Is lemon tea okay?

珠宝.s: 她正在一家珠宝店买珠宝。
珠宝.p: Tā zhèngzài yìjiā zhūbǎo diàn mǎi zhūbǎo.
珠宝.e: She is buying jewelry in a jewelry store.

公认.s: 鲸是被公认为最大的哺乳动物。
公认.p: Jīng shì bèi gōngrèn wèi zuì dà de bǔrǔdòngwù.
公认.e: The whale is well known to be the largest mammal.

看重.s: 我知道有些人看重我的工作。
看重.p: Wǒ zhīdào yǒuxiērén kànzhòng wǒ de gōngzuò.
看重.e: I know that some people value my work.

播种.e: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

照明.s: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
照明.p: Xiǎoqū ānquán ma? Yèwǎn yǒu zhàomíng shèshī ma?
照明.e: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?

眼看.s: 这个老人一只眼看不见了。
眼看.p: Zhège lǎorén yì zhǐ yǎnkàn bújiànle.
眼看.e: The old man is blind in one eye.

杰出.p: Tāngmǔ shì gè jiéchū de bàba.

拜年.s: 大妈, 我们给您拜年来啦！
拜年.p: Dàmā,  wǒmen gěi nín bàinián lái lā!
拜年.e: Auntie, we’ve come to wish you a Happy New Year.

海拔.s: 珠穆朗玛峰的海拔有多高？
海拔.p: ZhūmùlǎngmǎFēng de hǎibá yǒu duō gāo?
海拔.e: What is the height of Mt. Everest?

急救.p: Yīshēng, qǐng gěi zhè háizi jíjiù.
急救.e: Doctor, please give this child first aid.

叉.s: 请给我们两把刀和四把叉。
叉.p: Qǐng gěi wǒmen liǎng bǎ dāo hé sì bǎ chā.
叉.e: Give us two knives and four forks, please.

损坏.s: 货物毫无损坏地到达了。
损坏.p: Huòwù háowú sǔnhuài de dàodá le.

衰老.s: 衰老不得，智慧不得不得。

求助.e: You can ask him for help.

打动.p: Tā de yǎnshuō dǎdòng le wǒmen.

短缺.s: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
短缺.p: Jìnlái kāfēi de duǎnquē zàochéng le xǔduō wèntí.
短缺.e: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.

高原.s: 修学旅行，我们去了志贺高原滑雪。
高原.p: Xiū xué lǚxíng, wǒmen qù le zhì hè gāoyuán huáxuě.
高原.e: We went skiing in Shiga Kogen for our school trip.

启发.s: 他们的评论很有启发性。
启发.p: Tāmen de pínglùn hěn yǒu qǐfā xìng.

可行.p: Tā de zhǔyi zǒngshì kěxíng de.

科目.p: Shùxué shì tā zuì qiáng de kēmù.

讲解.s: 给他讲解一下你的困境。
讲解.p: Gěi tā jiǎngjiě yíxià nǐ de kùnjìng.
讲解.e: Explain to him the difficult situation you are in.

跳水.e: Ken stands on the diving board.

灾区.s: 红十字会不断地给灾区提供食物援助。
灾区.p: Hóngshízìhuì búduàn de gěi zāiqū tígōng shíwù yuánzhù.
灾区.e: The Red Cross constantly supplies food to the disaster areas.

受灾.s: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。
受灾.p: Jiùzhù rényuán jiàng wèi dìzhèn shòuzāi zhě fāfàng wùzī.
受灾.e: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.

解答.e: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.

议论.s: 我不喜欢别人在背后议论我。
议论.p: Wǒ bù xǐhuan biéren zài bèihòu yìlùn wǒ.
议论.e: I don't like people talking about me behind my back.

老太太.s: 那个老太太摔倒了爬不起来。
老太太.p: Nàge lǎotàitai shuāidǎo le pá bù qǐlai.
老太太.e: The old woman fell and could not get up.

终点.e: The bicycle is racing to finish.

吸取.s: 你必须从失败中吸取教训。
吸取.p: Nǐ bìxū cóng shībài zhōng xīqǔjiàoxun.

阻挡.s: 没有什么可以阻挡，我对自由的向往。
阻挡.p: Méiyǒushénme kěyǐ zǔdǎng, wǒ duì zìyóu de xiàngwǎng.
阻挡.e: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.

踏实.p: Wǒ shì gè jiǎotàshídì de rén.
踏实.e: I have my feet firmly planted on the ground.

助手.p: Wǒ búzài shì nǐ de zhùshǒu le.

打架.e: The argument ended in a fight.

围棋.e: I want to learn how to play "Go".

符号.e: An exclamation mark is a punctuation mark.

老实.p: Wǒ quèdìng tā shì gè lǎoshi rén.
老实.e: I am sure that he is an honest man.

闪电.e: The lightning lit up the sky.

肥胖.p: Hěn duō Měiguórén shì féipàng de.

木材.s: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。
木材.p: Xiànzài zhèng quē liánghǎo de jiànzhù mùcái.
木材.e: There is a shortage of good building wood.

墙壁.p: Tā dǎ le qiángbì yì quán.
墙壁.e: He hit the wall with his fist.

招收.s: 大学被招收了三个中国学生。
招收.p: Dàxué bèi zhāoshōu le sān gèzhōng guóxué shēng.
招收.e: Three Chinese students were admitted to the college.

至关重要.e: This is a matter of the utmost importance.

捉.s: 不管黑猫白猫，能捉老鼠就是好猫。
捉.p: Bùguǎn hēi māo bái māo, néng zhuō lǎoshǔ jiùshì hǎo māo.
捉.e: Whether it's white or black, a cat that chases mice is a good cat.

科普.s: 斯科普里是北马其顿的首都。
科普.e: Skopje is the capital of North Macedonia.

博览会.p: Bólǎnhuì jiàng jǔxíng liù gè yuè.
博览会.e: The exposition will be held for six months.

绘画.p: Tā yòng huìhuà lái zhuāngshì qiáng.
绘画.e: She decorated the wall with pictures.

同伴.e: An enemy of an enemy is a friend.

严禁.s: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。
严禁.p: Gāi guó yánjìn jìnkǒu xīyǒu yěshēngdòngwù.
严禁.e: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.

嗓子.s: 一根鱼刺卡在我嗓子里了。
嗓子.p: Yì gēn yúcì kǎ zài wǒ sǎngzi lǐ le.
嗓子.e: A fish bone has stuck in my throat.

专注.s: 她专注在她的新工作上。
专注.p: Tā zhuānzhù zài tā de xīn gōngzuò shàng.
专注.e: She applied her mind to her new job.

观赏.s: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。
观赏.p: Xuéxiào de yīnghuā kāi de lànmàn, xīyǐn le dàliàng shìmín qiánlái guānshǎng.
观赏.e: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.

观光.s: 他的工作是驾驶观光巴士。
观光.p: Tā de gōngzuò shì jiàshǐ guānguāng bāshì.
观光.e: His job is driving a sight-seeing bus.

太阳能.s: 在我们看来，太阳能电池是一项很好的投资。
太阳能.p: Zài wǒmen kànlai, tàiyángnéngdiànchí shì yí xiàng hěn hǎo de tóuzī.
太阳能.e: In our opinion, solar panels are a good investment.

滑雪.e: What do you say we go skiing?

好感.s: 她漂亮的外表赢得了很多男士的好感。
好感.p: Tā piàoliang de wàibiǎo yíngdé le hěn duō nánshì de hǎogǎn.
好感.e: Her good looks gained her the favor of many men.

昂贵.p: Tāmen dài zhe ángguì de jièzhi.

保管.p: Zhìyú gāi wénjiàn, wǒ zài bǎoguǎn.
保管.e: As for the papers, I have custody of them.

兼职.s: 她以前是兼职厨师，后来做了全职。
兼职.p: Tā yǐqián shì jiānzhí chúshī, hòulái zuò le quánzhí.
兼职.e: She used to be a part time chef, then she became full time.

称呼.s: 这鸟你们用英语怎么称呼？
称呼.p: Zhè niǎo nǐmen yòng Yīngyǔ zěnme chēnghu?
称呼.e: What do you call this bird in English?

相连.s: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？
相连.p: Shíyàn gòuzào shì zěnyàng de? Tāmen shì rúhé xiānglián jiē de?
相连.e: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?

优异.s: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
优异.p: Tā yǐ yōuyì de chéngjì bìyè yú JiànqiáoDàxué.
优异.e: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

贴近.s: 口语比书面语更贴近生活。
贴近.p: Kǒuyǔ bǐ shūmiànyǔ gēng tiējìn shēnghuó.
贴近.e: Spoken language is closer to life than written language.

听话.s: 他很会教育人所以他的孩子都很听话。
听话.p: Tā hěn huì jiàoyù rén suǒyǐ tā de háizi dōu hěn tīnghuà.
听话.e: He's a very good teacher, so his children really listen to him.

刹车.s: 刹车的功能是使车停下。
刹车.p: Shāchē de gōngnéng shì shǐ chē tíngxià.
刹车.e: The function of the brake is to stop the car.

野生.s: 为了看野生动物，他去了非洲。
野生.p: Wèile kàn yěshēngdòngwù, tā qù le Fēizhōu.
野生.e: He went to Africa to see wild animals.

月球.s: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
月球.p: Yuèqiú shì dìqiú wéiyì de wèixīng.
月球.e: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

为难.s: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
为难.p: Nàge tuántǐ wéinán mín men tígōng shípǐn gōngjǐ.
为难.e: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

农田.e: There is a path through the fields.

体操.e: We're supposed to do gymnastics now!

推测.s: 我在推测他可能赢得比赛。
推测.p: Wǒ zài tuīcè tā kěnéng yíngdé bǐsài.
推测.e: I am speculating that he may win the game.

报社.s: 我为这家报社工作四年了。
报社.p: Wǒ wèi zhè jiā bàoshè gōngzuò sì nián le.
报社.e: I have been working for this newspaper for 4 years.

耽误.s: 事故耽误了我们半小时。
耽误.e: An accident delayed us for half an hour.

演奏.s: 她小提琴演奏得非常好。
演奏.p: Tā xiǎotíqín yǎnzòu de fēicháng hǎo.
演奏.e: She plays the violin very well.

叙述.s: 详细叙述一下这起事故吧。
叙述.p: Xiángxì xùshù yíxià zhè qǐ shìgù ba.

传染.p: Tā bǎ gǎnmào chuánrǎn gěi wǒ le.
传染.e: He gave his cold to me.

争吵.s: 她一直和她的兄弟争吵。
争吵.p: Tā yìzhí hé tā de xiōngdì zhēngchǎo.
争吵.e: She was always quarreling with her brothers.

描绘.s: 我不是诗人，无法用一行文字描绘它的美丽。
描绘.p: Wǒ búshì shīrén, wúfǎ yòng yìxíng wénzì miáohuì tā de měilì.
描绘.e: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.

夸.p: Wǒ jiù dāng nǐ kuā wǒ le.
夸.e: I'll take that as a compliment.

舌头.p: Kào! Wǒ yǎo dào zìjǐ shétou le.

恰好.s: 着火的时候我妈妈恰好在那。
恰好.p: Zháohuǒ de shíhou wǒ māma qiàhǎo zài nà.
恰好.e: My mother happened to be there when the fire broke out.

嘲笑.p: Tā bèi tā de péngyou cháoxiào le.
嘲笑.e: He was laughed at by his friends.

出入.s: 他有权出入美国大使馆。
出入.e: He has access to the American Embassy.

歌唱.s: 我能听见鸟在窗外歌唱。
歌唱.p: Wǒ néng tīngjiàn niǎo zài chuāng wài gēchàng.
歌唱.e: I could hear birds singing outside my window.

众所周知.s: 众所周知，空气是多种气体的混合体。
众所周知.p: Zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, kōngqì shì duōzhǒng qìtǐ de hùnhétǐ.
众所周知.e: As everyone knows, air is a mixture of gases.

方言.s: 你认为这是语言还是方言？
方言.p: Nǐ rènwéi zhè shì yǔyán háishi fāngyán?
方言.e: Do you think this is a language or a dialect?

间隔.p: Tā jiàngé le hěn jiǔ cái zuòdá.
间隔.e: There was a long interval before he replied.

花朵.s: 苹果树上挂着美丽的花朵。
花朵.p: Píngguǒ shù shàng guà zhe měilì de huāduǒ.
花朵.e: The apple tree has a beautiful blossom.

仍旧.s: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。

香肠.p: Nǐ yào péigēn háishi yào xiāngcháng?
香肠.e: Would you like bacon or sausage?

钟头.s: 我女儿每天睡八个钟头。
钟头.p: Wǒ nǚér měitiān shuì bā gè zhōngtóu.
钟头.e: My daughter sleeps eight hours a day.

粘贴.p: Fùzhì/ zhāntiē shì hěn yǒuyòng de.

转交.s: 我见了罗伊，他叫我把这个转交给你。
转交.p: Wǒ jiàn le luó yī, tā jiào wǒ bǎ zhège zhuǎnjiāo gěi nǐ.
转交.e: I saw Roy and he asked me to pass this along to you.

国歌.s: 爱沙尼亚有它自己的国歌。
国歌.p: Àishāníyà yǒu tā zìjǐ de guógē.
国歌.e: Estonia has its own national anthem.

多亏.p: Duōkuī le nǐ, wǒ hái huózhe.
多亏.e: I owe it you that I am still alive.

益处.s: 去美国学习对我来说是否有益处，还有待考虑。
益处.p: Qù Měiguó xuéxí duìwǒláishuō shìfǒu yǒuyìchu, háiyǒu dàikǎo lǜ.
益处.e: It remains to be seen whether or not going to America to study is good for me.

一帆风顺.s: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。
一帆风顺.p: Wǒmen lùshang yìfānfēngshùn, zhídào yùshàng bàofēngxuě.
一帆风顺.e: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.

插座.s: 我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。
插座.p: Wǒ bǎ guǒjiàng sā dào diànyuánchāzuò shàng duǎnlù le.
插座.e: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.

空闲.s: 您空闲时间喜欢做什么？
空闲.p: Nín kòngxián shíjiān xǐhuan zuò shénme?
空闲.e: What do you like to do in your free time?

马虎.s: 我从马来西亚来的妈妈觉得那三匹马马马虎虎。
马虎.p: Wǒ cóng Mǎláixīyà lái de māma juéde nà sān pǐ mǎ mǎmahūhū.
马虎.e: My mother from Malaysia thinks that those three horses are so-so.

家常.e: Both victory and defeat are but an everyday occurrence to a soldier.

种地.p: Zélán yǔ shì zhòngdì qū yǔyán.

轮子.s: 坏的轮子会嘎嘎响很久。
轮子.p: Huài de lúnzi huì gāgā xiǎng hěn jiǔ.
轮子.e: Bad wheels will squeal a lot.

补习.e: She has to take a remedial course in English.

母语.p: Nǐ de mǔyǔ shì Zhōngwén ma?

钢笔.p: Zhè zhī gāngbǐ yào duōshǎo qián?

拐弯.s: 你到这儿拐弯角上去坐地铁。
拐弯.p: Nǐ dào zhèr guǎiwān jiǎo shàngqù zuò dìtiě.
拐弯.e: Turn here to get on the subway.

音节.p: Zhège cí yǒu duōshǎo gè yīnjié?
音节.e: How many syllables are in this word?

用功.s: 就我所知，他是个很用功的学生。
用功.p: Jiù wǒ suǒzhī, tā shì gè hěn yònggōng de xuésheng.
用功.e: He is an industrious student to the best of my knowledge.

晕车.s: 我的儿子每次乘坐公交车都会晕车。
晕车.p: Wǒ de érzi měicì chéngzuò gōngjiāochē dūhuì yùnchē.
晕车.e: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.

声调.e: There was a sudden change in her tone.

灰心.s: 他很坚强，不会那么容易灰心。
灰心.p: Tā hěn jiānqiáng, búhuì nàme róngyì huīxīn.
灰心.e: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.

味觉.s: 舌头和上颚都是味觉器官。
味觉.p: Shétou hé shàng è dōu shì wèijué qìguān.
味觉.e: The tongue and the palate are the taste organs.

必修.s: 烹饪课程应该作为学校的必修课。
必修.p: Pēngrèn kèchéng yīnggāi zuòwéi xuéxiào de bìxiūkè.
必修.e: A cooking course should be mandatory in schools.

南美洲.e: Australia is smaller than South America.

养老院.s: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。
养老院.p: Wǒmen jīntiān de qù yǎnglǎoyuàn chànggē.
养老院.e: We have to sing at an old folks home today.

打雷.p: Wàimiàn dǎléi le, wǒ hěn hàipà!
打雷.e: It's thundering outside. I'm really scared!

大洋洲.s: 澳大利亚是大洋洲最大的国家。
大洋洲.p: Àodàlìyà shì Dàyángzhōu zuì dà de guójiā.
大洋洲.e: Australia is the largest country in Oceania.

衣食住行.s: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
衣食住行.p: Háizimen de yīshízhùxíng kào de shì tāmen de fùmǔ.
衣食住行.e: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.

好客.s: 所有的客人都被她的好客感动了。
好客.p: Suǒyǒu de kèrén dōu bèi tā de hàokè gǎndòng le.
好客.e: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.

诚信.s: 诚信是一种重要的美德。
诚信.p: Chéngxìn shì yìzhǒng zhòngyào de měidé.

大幅.s: 这个政策导致物价大幅度的上升。
大幅.p: Zhège zhèngcè dǎozhì wùjià dàfúdù de shàngshēng.
大幅.e: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.

动漫.p: Nǐ yǒu nǎxiē tuījiàn de dòngmàn?

多余.p: Nǐ yǒu duōyú de yàoshi ma?
多余.e: Do you have an extra key?

好不.e: Am I singing that song well?

家居.s: 我很惊讶，你家居然有辆日本车。
家居.p: Wǒ hěn jīngyà, nǐ jiājū rán yǒu liàng Rìběn chē.
家居.e: I am surprised that your family has a Japanese car.

摄像头.s: 汤姆没有注意到监控摄像头。
摄像头.p: Tāngmǔ méiyǒu zhùyì dào jiānkòng shèxiàngtóu.
摄像头.e: Tom didn't notice the surveillance camera.

事后.s: 但是，当然啦，事后诸葛亮总是好当。
事后.p: Dànshì, dāngrán lā, shìhòuZhūgěLiàng zǒngshì hǎo dāng.

套餐.e: I'd like to buy menu of the day.

沿海.s: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。
沿海.p: Zhōngguódàlù de yánhǎi chéngshì pǔbiàn bǐ nèilù chéngshì fādá.
沿海.e: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.

一一.p: Jīnnián shì èr líng yìyì nián.
